{{main|2007 WTA Tour}}

The [[WTA Tier I tournaments]] are part of the elite tour for professional women's [[tennis]] organised by the [[Women's Tennis Association|WTA]] called the [[WTA Tour]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=2007 Tournaments {{!}} WTA Official |url=https://www.wtatennis.com/tournaments/2007 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://archive.today/20220920190410/https://www.wtatennis.com/tournaments/2007|archive-date=2022-09-20 |publisher=Women's Tennis Association }}</ref>
